mapper.sql: SELECT USER_ID, SUM(DECODE(ROLE_POS, #{rolePos01}, 1, #{rolePos02}, 1, #{rolePos03}, 1, 0)) ISLEADERCOUNT, SUM(DECODE(ROLE_POS, #{rolePos05}, 1, 0)) ISMANAGERCOUNT, SUM(DECODE(ROLE_POS, #{rolePos06}, 1, 0)) ISTRADERCOUNT FROM (SELECT SUR.USER_ID, SR.ROLE_POS ROLE_POS FROM SYS_USER_ROLE SUR LEFT JOIN SYS_ROLE SR ON SUR.ROLE_ID = SR.ROLE_ID WHERE SUR.USER_ID = #{loginUserName}) GROUP BY USER_ID

LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ON PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID = WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp1 ON fp1.FINPROD_ID = WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CHL_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ON WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = WFL_PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY ON MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID = WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.COUNTER_ID

SELECT WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID tradeId, fp1.FINPROD_NAME chlFinprodId, #{tradeStatus01} AS validStatus, WFL_TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.PS ps, CASE WHEN MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_TYPE= #{COUNTER_TYPE_05} THEN #{YES_NO_Y} ELSE #{YES_NO_N} END isOutTrade, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket,

LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ON PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID = WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp1 ON fp1.FINPROD_ID = WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.CHL_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY ON MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID = WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.COUNTER_ID

case when TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_MARKET_MODE='01' then '01' else '02' end as tradeMarketMode, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CCY ccy, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SETTLE_DATE settleDate, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.REMARK remark, null AS workflowId, null AS workflowStatus, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BACK_LEND_DIRECTION backLendDirection, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.COUNTER_ID COUNTER_ID, MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_NAME counterName, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.F_TRADE_ID fTradeId, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.UNIT_CPRICE unitCprice, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.UNIT_INT*100 unitInt, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.UNIT_FPRICE unitFprice, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PAR_VALUE parValue, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.YIELD*100 yield, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.EXER_YIELD*100 exerYield FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = PTL_TRADE.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ON PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_TRADE.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp1 ON fp1.FINPROD_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CHL_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY ON MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PTL_PORTFOLIO1 ON PTL_PORTFOLIO1.PORTFOLIO_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID

SELECT case when TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.PS = #{PS_T75} and TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F07' then TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID else TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID end tradeId, fp1.FINPROD_NAME chlFinprodId, #{tradeStatus02} AS validStatus, TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.PS ps, CASE WHEN MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_TYPE= #{COUNTER_TYPE_05} THEN #{YES_NO_Y} ELSE #{YES_NO_N} END isOutTrade, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket,

LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ON PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp1 ON fp1.FINPROD_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.CHL_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY ON MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.COUNTER_ID

SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId,/* add by songyawei */ ENTRUST_ID code FROM ETR_ENTRUST
ENTRUST_ID like concat(concat('%', #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')

SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, FINPROD_ABBR shortName FROM FIN_PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID
(FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%', #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%', #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
AND FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_8 IS NOT NULL

SELECT TRIM(TO_CHAR(YIELD*100,99990.9999)) AS INVEST_RATE FROM ( SELECT NVL(PA.YIELD,0) YIELD FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE PA LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FIN ON FIN.CASH_ID = PA.CASH_ID WHERE /*modify by liupeilin 2020-01-17 begin*/ FIN.FINPROD_ID like '%'||#{assetId} /*modify by liupeilin 2020-01-17 end*/ AND FIN.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' AND PA.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ORDER BY PA.UPDATE_TIME DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT TRIM(TO_CHAR(NVL(T4.YIELD,0)*100,99990.9999)) AS INVEST_RATE FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T2 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T4 ON T2.CASH_ID = T4.CASH_ID /*modify by liupeilin 2020-01-17 begin*/ AND T2.FINPROD_ID like '%'||#{assetId} /*modify by liupeilin 2020-01-17 end*/ AND t2.CASH_TYPE_1 = '02' WHERE T4.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T3 WHERE T4.CASH_ID = T3.CASH_ID AND T3.EFF_DATE > T4.EFF_DATE AND T3.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))

SELECT TRD_ALL.portfolioId, /*组合代码*/ TRD_ALL.portfolioName, /*组合名称*/ TRD_ALL.finprodType2, /*资产类型*/ SDL1.ITEM_VALUE finprodTypeStr,/*资产类型*/ TRD_ALL.finprodId, TRD_ALL.finprodMarketId, /*资产代码*/ unitCprice,/*交易价格 */ TRD_ALL.tradeDate, TRD_ALL.tradeDateStr,/*交易日*/ TRD_ALL.COUNTER_ID, TRD_ALL.counterName /*交易对手 */ FROM ( ( SELECT WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID tradeId,
